newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-July fixed asset investment hits 640 bln.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-July fixed asset investment hits 640 bln.

text.p: Fixed asset investment in China hit 639.2 billion yuan ($77 billion) in the first seven months, up 10.5 percent year-on-year but down 3.8 percentage points from first-half growth, state figures showed on Tuesday.
The slowdown was due to hot weather, postponements of construction projects and delays in investment funds reaching target projects, the State Statistical Bureau said without giving details.
Basic construction investment grew 16 percent to 367.4 billion yuan from January to July, while investment in renovation increased 9.3 percent to 124.6 billion yuan, it said.
Real estate investment fell 2.0 percent to 112.8 billion yuan, and other types of investment grew 4.6 percent to 34.4 billion yuan, it said.
Fixed asset investment for the entire year was expected to rise 12.7 percent, economists have said.
